answer_1.quote: The task of personalized target-oriented dialogue is formalized as follows: given a target T , a set of user's personalized information U, a set of relevant domain knowledge K, and a dialogue context C, the objective is to proactively lead the conversation and generate proper utterances to achieve the target T at an appropriate time.

answer_2.quote: Our evaluation metrics include the average score of BLEU-1/2 , persona F1 , knowledge F1 and target success rate (Succ.) .

answer_3.quote: We employ the gpt-3.5-turbo version of ChatGPT to compare each pair of dialogues.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three well-educated graduate students as evaluators and ask them to perform a blind pairwise comparison.
answer_4.guideline: We ask ChatGPT and human evaluators to compare each pair of dialogues in terms of the following metrics: proactivity (Proact.), coherence (Coh.), personalization (Pers.), and target success rate (Succ.)
